== Card credits ==
Jeremy Gardner is credited with the original concept of seven Players Committee [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The concept credit names where the concept was won: PC Volunteer Award 2009. The cards are in [[Virtual Block 6]] (released 2009–2010), [[Virtual Set 0]] (released 24 September 2014), [[Virtual Set 3]] (released 4 December 2015), [[Virtual Set 6]] (released 14 April 2017) and [[Virtual Set 8]] (released 30 November 2017).
